profile.name: Reyhan Chill
profile.bio: Building reliable software for real-world problems, with a focus on backend systems, APIs and data-driven applications.

projects.title: TAXFLOW
projects.description: A UK tax calculation and decision-support application for individuals, self-employed workers and small businesses.
projects.fullDescription: TaxFlow is my final-year project: a UK tax calculation and decision-support application built with Next.js, TypeScript and React, with PostgreSQL accessed through Prisma. The calculation engine is separated from the interface so tax rules can be tested independently. Next.js server actions handle account and saved-calculation operations, with Zod validating inputs.
keyFeatures: Per-employment PAYE calculations and tax-code validation
National Insurance, student-loan, pension and capital-gains calculations
Rule-based recommendations based on the calculation inputs
Account registration, email verification and password reset
Saved tax entries, data export and account deletion
Vitest tests for tax-calculation boundaries

projects.title: MONEY SNAPSHOT
projects.description: A personal-finance prototype exploring how to explain one useful next action from a financial snapshot.
projects.fullDescription: Money Snapshot is an early-stage personal-finance decision-support project using synthetic data. A JavaScript research prototype calculates a prioritised next action and explains the facts, calculation, interpretation and uncertainty behind it. A separate Next.js and TypeScript web-app foundation provides responsive Snapshot and Dashboard screens with demonstration data.
keyFeatures: Six synthetic scenarios for testing the recommendation logic
Data-sufficiency checks before financial calculations
Deterministic cash-flow, emergency-buffer and debt-priority logic
Traceable explanations of each recommendation
Separate Snapshot and Dashboard UI foundation
Automated tests for the JavaScript decision engine

projects.title: AI INTERVIEW COACH
projects.description: An interview-preparation application in development by a team of three developers.
projects.fullDescription: AI Interview Coach is a work-in-progress project developed by a team of three. My focus is the frontend and APIs. The current codebase has a React and TypeScript frontend built with Vite, alongside a Python/FastAPI backend and SQLAlchemy models for PostgreSQL. The interview and results screens are scaffolding; AI question generation and automated feedback remain planned functionality.
keyFeatures: Three-developer collaboration; my focus is frontend and APIs
React Router page and layout scaffolding
Shared frontend API client
FastAPI application and initial router setup
Database models for users, CVs, interviews, questions, answers and feedback

projects.title: ZUMUNTA COMMUNITY MASJID
projects.description: A first-stage community website MVP for Zumunta Community Masjid in Birmingham.
projects.fullDescription: A first-stage MVP built with Next.js, TypeScript, React and Tailwind CSS. It brings mosque information, community services and calculated prayer begin times into a responsive site, with a next-prayer countdown that uses the Europe/London timezone. Sanity Studio and content schemas are scaffolded for future staff editing; the current public content is maintained locally.
keyFeatures: Calculated prayer begin times from the AlAdhan API
Timezone-aware next-prayer countdown
Mosque information, services and contact details
Responsive navigation with keyboard-accessible controls
Sanity Studio and content schemas prepared for later configuration
Playwright journey and accessibility test coverage
